name: Daniel Rivera
tagline: Math and computing at UC Berkeley
intro: I study math and computing at UC Berkeley, and I love quant. Most of what I build starts as a hunch I want to test, whether that’s with market data, a deck of cards, or three robots.
introMore: I’m outgoing, and I’m devoted: whatever I take on, I want to do it as well as I can.
Away from the laptop I train full body every other day, love kiwis, and run a resale shop I started with $25. Faith is a big part of who I am.

workIntro: Experiments, simulations, and tools I’ve built. Each project page has the question I started with and what came out of it.

about.label: Who I am
paragraphs: I’m studying math and computing at UC Berkeley. I love quant, and I’m especially interested in probability and in how models hold up when assumptions about data, costs, or behavior change.
I’m outgoing, and I’m devoted to doing my best at whatever I take on. I made this site so that someone curious about the same things can see how I went about a project and try something similar.

about.label: How I got here
paragraphs: I went to Palmdale High School, in its Engineering Academy, and took community college classes alongside it. I entered Berkeley with 45 college credits.

In 2025 I was a MITES Semester scholar. One of my first projects was a poker equity simulator I built there. It made a question that felt intuitive into something I could actually compute. Since then I’ve used simulation to explore market risk, worked with three robots to study crowding, and built an educational health model that shows the range of outcomes its assumptions can produce.

outside.title: Health
outside.text: I train full body every other day and I care about what I eat. I love kiwis. In high school I swam varsity.

outside.title: Faith
outside.text: Faith is a big part of who I am. From 2025 to 2026 I helped run sound for weekly services at my church, with about 150 people in the room and about 300 on the livestream.

outside.title: The shop
outside.text: In 2022 I started a resale shop with $25. I’ve filled more than 600 orders since, and running it gave me a reason to build small tools I’d actually use.

outside.title: Quant
outside.text: I love quant. I started studying NQ and ES futures on my own in 2021, and the research workbench grew out of that.
